# Jim's Quality Painting

> Residential and commercial painting contractor serving Central Connecticut for over 20 years. Founded and owned by Jim B.

## Services

- Interior painting
- Exterior painting
- Residential painting
- Commercial painting
- Deck and arbor painting / staining
- Cabinet refinishing

## Service area

Central Connecticut — Hartford County and surrounding towns including Hartford, West Hartford, New Britain, Bristol, Newington, Wethersfield, Manchester, and Glastonbury.
